name: @fastmcp-me/xhs-mcp
stderr:
Usage: xhs-mcp [options] [command]

XiaoHongShu CLI with subcommands

Options:
  --compact              Output compact one-line JSON (no pretty print)
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]        Start XiaoHongShu login flow (opens browser, saves
                         cookies)
  logout                 Logout from XiaoHongShu and clear saved cookies
  status                 Check current XiaoHongShu login status
  browser [options]      Ensure Puppeteer Chromium is installed and launchable;
                         installs if missing
  feeds [options]        Discover home page feeds
  search [options]       Search notes by keyword
  note-detail [options]  Get detailed information about a specific note
  comment [options]      Comment on a note
  publish [options]      Publish content to XiaoHongShu (supports both images
                         and videos)
  mcp [options]          Start XHS MCP server (stdio or http mode)
  tools [options]        List available MCP tools
  help [command]         display help for command
